name: MECW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Vacant when the promotion returned from its hiatus, first won by Corey Irons on 2 May 2001 with no opponent named, then taken from him by Johnny Eastland on a later Main Event broadcast; no further change survives.

name: MECW Television Championship
epitaph: Left vacant, first won by Corey Irons over the Iron Predator on 9 May 2001, then, once vacant again, won by Johnny Eastland over Jaguar by 7 June 2001; no further change survives.

name: MECW World Championship
epitaph: Crowned for the first time in a tournament at MECW's debut pay-per-view, Hell Night, on 26 May 2001, when Corey Irons beat Johnny Eastland in the final; a rematch was promised for early June but no result survives.

name: MECW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: First won by the Misfits on the same broadcast where Johnny Eastland took the Hardcore title; the promotion's own report names neither their opponents nor the title's founding date, and no further change survives.
